programs.name: psbbox
programs.purpose: Replace selected coordinates in the first concrete BoundingBox comment of a PostScript file.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: PSBBOX - change BoundingBOX of existing PostScript file

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print old and new bounding boxes to stderr.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Floating-point BoundingBox coordinates are rounded with NINT. The initial integer sscanf can accept integer prefixes of decimal values.
programs.difficulty_reason: It rewrites one text comment while copying the rest of the input.

test_cases.description: Replace two coordinates in generated PostScript.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sustrip | psgraph n=32 d1=1 > in.ps && psbbox llx=20 ury=500 verbose=0 < in.ps

test_cases.description: Keep the generated bounding box while reporting it.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sustrip | psgraph n=32 d1=1 > in.ps && psbbox verbose=1 < in.ps

programs.name: pscontour
programs.purpose: Draw contours of a two-dimensional array of floats as PostScript.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: PSCONTOUR - PostScript CONTOURing of a two-dimensional function f(x1,x2)

params.name: n1
params.description: First dimension count; required unless x1 is supplied.

params.name: x1
params.description: First dimension coordinates; its length overrides n1.

params.name: d1
params.description: First dimension sampling interval when x1 is absent.

params.name: f1
params.description: First coordinate when x1 is absent.

params.name: n2
params.default: computed: input file float count divided by n1
params.description: Second dimension count; supply it or x2 for piped input.

params.name: x2
params.description: Second dimension coordinates; its length overrides n2.

params.name: d2
params.description: Second dimension sampling interval when x2 is absent.

params.name: f2
params.description: First coordinate when x2 is absent.

params.name: c
params.description: Explicit contour values; overrides nc, dc and fc.

params.name: cwidth
params.description: Contour widths; the last supplied value repeats.

params.name: cgray
params.description: Contour gray levels; the last supplied value repeats.

params.name: cdash
params.description: Contour dash spacings; the last supplied value repeats.

params.name: ccolor
params.description: Comma-separated contour colors; the last supplied value repeats.

params.name: labelcf
params.description: First labeled contour, numbered from one.

params.name: d1num
params.description: Axis 1 numbered tick interval; zero selects automatic.

params.name: f2num
params.description: First numbered axis 2 tick; code differs from selfdoc.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Contour interpolation and labeling in psContour, axis scaling, floating-point comparisons, and PostScript formatting affect reproducibility. Arrays are fixed at 200 contour entries without a bounds check; degenerate axes or contour spacing can divide by zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers a two-dimensional grid and delegates contour tracing and labeling to the plotting library.

test_cases.description: Generate contours from a piped grid.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=8 | sustrip | pscontour n1=32 n2=8 nc=4 style=normal > out.ps

test_cases.description: Use explicit coordinates and contour styling.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=8 ntr=4 | sustrip | pscontour x1=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 x2=0,1,2,3 c=-0.5,0.5 ccolor=red,blue cdash=2 nlabelc=0 > out.ps

programs.name: pscube
programs.purpose: Draw three image faces of a data cube as PostScript, optionally with a color legend.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: PSCUBE - PostScript image plot with Legend of a data CUBE

params.name: faces
params.description: Read three consecutive faces instead of a full cube.

params.name: front
params.description: Front face file; front, side and top must be supplied together.

params.name: side
params.description: Side face file; all three face files must be supplied together.

params.name: top
params.description: Top face file; all three face files must be supplied together.

params.name: bhls
params.description: HLS color at black clip; used when RGB parameters are absent.

params.name: whls
params.description: HLS color at white clip; used when RGB parameters are absent.

params.name: bps
params.description: Color image bits per pixel; must be 12 or 24 when read.

params.name: clip
params.description: Sets bclip=clip and wclip=-clip unless individually overridden.

params.name: bclip
params.default: computed: bperc percentile of face samples
params.description: Black clip; defaults to clip when clip is supplied.

params.name: wclip
params.default: computed: wperc percentile of face samples
params.description: White clip; defaults to -clip when clip is supplied.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Report clipping values; 2 also reports legend data range.

params.name: x1end
params.description: Axis 1 end, snapped to a sample.

params.name: x2beg
params.description: Axis 2 beginning, snapped to a sample.

params.name: x3end
params.description: Axis 3 end, snapped to a sample.

params.name: legendfont
params.description: Read but not used in drawing the legend.

params.name: lfnum
params.description: Read as first legend tick but the drawing call uses lf instead.

params.name: lstyle
params.description: Legend orientation: vertleft, vertright or horibottom.

params.name: lx
params.default: computed: 0.8, or position from box and size for other styles

params.name: ly
params.default: computed: centered on cube, or 1.0 for horibottom

params.name: lntic
params.description: Documented only; code hard-codes one and never reads this parameter.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Percentile selection, float-to-byte truncation, interpolation, HLS conversion, and sin/cos/tan and float/double mixing affect output. The grayscale detection checks RGB values even for HLS mode, so some HLS choices can be treated as grayscale. Zero sampling intervals and degenerate dimensions can cause divisions by zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: It extracts and resamples three cube faces, clips and colors samples, and constructs projected images and a legend.

test_cases.description: Plot a small cube with percentile clipping.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=16 ntr=16 | sustrip | pscube n1=16 n2=4 n3=4 perc=95 angle=30 verbose=0 > out.ps
suplane nt=16 ntr=16 | sustrip | pscube n1=16 n2=4 n3=4 brgb=0,0,1 wrgb=1,0,0 bps=24 d1s=0.5 legend=1 lstyle=horibottom verbose=0 > out.ps

programs.license_note: HLS-to-RGB routines are adapted from Foley & Van Dam; legend additions are credited to Claudia Vanelle, University of Hamburg.

programs.name: pscubecontour
programs.purpose: Draw contour plots on three projected faces of a data cube as PostScript.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: PSCCONTOUR - PostScript Contour plot of a data CUBE

params.name: n3
params.description: Third dimension count; must be at least two.

params.name: faces
params.description: Read three faces consecutively instead of a cube.

params.name: front
params.description: Front face file; all three face files must be supplied together.

params.name: side
params.description: Side face file; all three face files must be supplied together.

params.name: top
params.description: Top face file; all three face files must be supplied together.

params.name: d1s
params.description: Documented only; never read or applied.

params.name: d2s
params.description: Documented only; never read or applied.

params.name: d3s
params.description: Documented only; never read or applied.

params.name: cgray
params.description: Contour gray levels; last value repeats.

params.name: cdash
params.description: Contour dash spacings; last value repeats.

params.name: ccolor
params.description: Comma-separated contour colors; last value repeats.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Contour tracing and interpolation, projected coordinate scaling, sin/cos/tan, and float/double mixing affect output. Contour arrays have 200 entries without bounds checks, and degenerate axes or spacing can divide by zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: It extracts cube faces and combines projected coordinate transforms with contour tracing and labeling.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=16 ntr=16 | sustrip | pscubecontour n1=16 n2=4 n3=4 nc=4 angle=30 > out.ps

test_cases.description: Read consecutive faces and use explicit contours.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=8 ntr=16 | sustrip | pscubecontour n1=8 n2=4 n3=4 faces=1 c=-0.5,0.5 ccolor=red,blue nlabelc=0 > out.ps

programs.license_note: The header credits Claudia Vanelle, University of Hamburg, with merging pscube and pscontour.

programs.name: psepsi
programs.purpose: Add a Ghostscript-rendered preview bitmap to an EPS file.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: PSEPSI - add an EPSI formatted preview bitmap to an EPS file
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Preview pixels depend on the installed Ghostscript version and rendering behavior; the embedded PostScript uses legacy Ghostscript device operators.
programs.difficulty_reason: It coordinates temporary files, a Ghostscript subprocess, and insertion of a rendered bitmap into EPS comments.

test_cases.description: Add a preview to generated EPS.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sustrip | psgraph n=32 d1=1 > in.eps && psepsi < in.eps > out.epsi

test_cases.description: Preview an EPS with a modified bounding box.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sustrip | psgraph n=32 d1=1 | psbbox llx=0 lly=0 urx=300 ury=300 verbose=0 > in.eps && psepsi < in.eps > out.epsi

programs.name: psgraph
programs.purpose: Plot one or more curves from binary coordinates or generated regular coordinates as PostScript.

params.name: n
params.description: Point counts per plot; n or its alias n1 is required, and the final value repeats.

params.name: n1
params.description: Alias for n, used only when n is absent.

params.name: n2
params.description: Alias for nplot; nplot takes precedence.

params.name: pairs
params.description: One for interleaved coordinate pairs, zero for separate coordinate arrays; last supplied value repeats.

params.name: d1
params.description: Regular first-coordinate intervals; last supplied value repeats.

params.name: f1
params.description: Regular first-coordinate origins; last supplied value repeats.

params.name: d2
params.description: Regular second-coordinate intervals; last supplied value repeats.

params.name: f2
params.description: Regular second-coordinate origins; last supplied value repeats.

params.name: reverse
params.description: Set to one to draw curves in reverse order.

params.name: mark
params.description: Marker indices; last supplied value repeats.

params.name: marksize
params.description: Marker sizes; last supplied value repeats.

params.name: linewidth
params.description: Line widths; last supplied value repeats.

params.name: lineon
params.description: Dash lengths; last supplied value repeats.

params.name: lineoff
params.description: Dash gaps; last supplied value repeats.

params.name: linegray
params.description: Line gray levels; last supplied value repeats.

params.name: linecolor
params.description: Comma-separated line colors; last supplied value repeats.

params.name: f2num
params.description: First numbered axis 2 tick; code differs from selfdoc.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Regular coordinate generation and axis scaling use float arithmetic mixed with double constants; PostScript number formatting and axis routines can vary. Explicit equal axis endpoints can cause division by zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers multiple curves and supports several coordinate input layouts and per-curve styles.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=1 | sustrip | psgraph n=64 d1=0.004 linecolor=blue grid1=dot > out.ps

test_cases.description: Plot two curves with markers and reversed drawing order.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=2 | sustrip | psgraph n=32,32 d1=1,1 reverse=1 mark=2,5 marksize=3,3 linecolor=red,blue lineoff=2,0 > out.ps
suplane nt=32 ntr=2 | sustrip | psgraph n=32 pairs=0 style=seismic > out.ps

programs.license_note: The header credits modifications by Morten Wendell Pedersen of Aarhus University and James Gunning of CSIRO.
